en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own move and get the same check on residence rules, small business status, banking, insurance and the cat
en.runTitle: Warsaw to Tbilisi for 2027: a Ukrainian backend developer on about EUR 4,500 a month, with a cat

fields.label: Passport and residence status

en.template: Help me assess a year in Tbilisi from Warsaw starting {start}. I hold {status}, invoice {income}, spend {costs}, retain {registrations}, and travel with {cat}. Compare housing at {housing}, identify work/SBS, banking, insurance and pet-document gates, and calculate savings only after {tax}. Ask before contacting anyone, sharing documents, applying or paying.

phases.title: Read Georgian and Polish official rules on stay, work, tax, banks, insurance and bringing a cat, and collect dated rent listings
phases.note: Residence and work rules, small business tax, bank and insurance terms, pet import
phases.judgment: One colleague withdrew its own earlier claims about bank packages, insurance prices and an official list it said it had inspected, because it could not show where it had read them, and told the team not to publish them as verified. Another warned against saying every foreign remote contractor needs a work permit, and found that a new Ukrainian arrival gets one year, not two or three.

phases.title: Write the guide with a monthly budget in lari and euro, and start the independent review
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer re-ran all 91 figure checks with no failures, but still caught a flaw in the savings formula that could subtract continuing foreign tax twice. It was corrected before the guide was delivered.

phases.title: Fix the formula, re-check the numbers and test desktop and phone layouts

workers: Read the current Georgian rules on how long Ukrainians can stay, work-permit questions and residence permit routes
Read the Georgian Revenue Service rules on small business status: 1% turnover tax, conditions, filing deadlines and registration fees
Looked into bank accounts, health insurance and cat import rules, and corrected what could not be backed up by a page actually read
Independently recomputed every money figure in the finished guide and checked its claims against the source list
